newsitem.title: UK: JKX Oil says had material H1 asset growth.
newsitem.headline: JKX Oil says had material H1 asset growth.

text.p: Britain's JKX Oil & Gas Plc, which agreed last week to be taken over by Ramco Energy Plc, said on Friday its net current assets grew materially in the first half due to new gas deliveries and a recent rights issue.
JKX said a total of about $1.02 million had been received for gas delivered under the terms of a Ukraine deal between its 49-percent-owned Poltava Petroleum Co (PPC) unit and Ukrgas.
JKX, which agreed to a 54 million stg takeover bid from Ramco, planned to include the delivery revenues in its results for the first half ended on June 30.
The company said PPC's first-half oil production averaged 5,817 barrels per day, up 15 percent compared to the previous six-month period.
PPC's gas production averaged 32 million cubic feet per day during the first half, compared to 30 million in the previous six-month period.
JKX's shares were marked up 0.5p at 42.5 by 0710 GMT.
JKX planned to report its results around August 15.
In February, JKX said it planned to raise about 14.2 million stg as a result of a two-for-three rights issue at a price of 34p. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
